heightEncoding.note: The grid is authoritative for walkability. The Godot loader takes elevation from the rendered walk surfaces, not from this file.

notes: Every terrain sub-mesh is named Terrain_<class>; every built walkable surface is named Walk_<...>. The client turns both into the navigation collision layer the grounding ray tests.
Bridges and canopy platforms are walk surfaces, so a downward grounding ray under one resolves onto the deck above; the terrain beneath them is water or ravine and is not walkable.
